description: This file defines a Python class 'CustomOpenAPISpec' that contains static methods for customizing and manipulating OpenAPI specifications, especially in relation to integrating Pydantic models for request schemas, handling schema references, and injecting request body schemas into specific API paths. It is part of a larger project concerned with API schema generation and documentation.

classes.name: CustomOpenAPISpec
classes.description: A handler class providing static methods to modify and enhance OpenAPI specifications with schemas derived from Pydantic models, aimed at improving API documentation and Swagger UI display without affecting runtime validation.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_pydantic_schema(model_class)
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON schema from a given Pydantic model class, supporting both v1 and v2 APIs.

methods.name: None add_schema_to_components(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], schema_name: str, schema_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a schema definition to the OpenAPI components/schemas section.

methods.name: None add_request_body_to_paths(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], paths: List[str], schema_ref: str)
methods.description: Adds an expanded request body schema to specified API paths for better visibility in Swagger UI.

methods.name: None _move_defs_to_components(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], defs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Moves $defs from Pydantic v2 schemas to OpenAPI components/schemas, facilitating schema resolution.

methods.name: Any _rewrite_defs_refs(schema: Any)
methods.description: Recursively rewrites $ref references from Pydantic $defs format to OpenAPI-compatible component references.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _extract_field_schema(field_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Produces a simplified schema suitable for display as a parameter in OpenAPI from a complex Pydantic field definition.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _expand_field_definition(field_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Prepares a field definition for inline inclusion in OpenAPI schema to enable Swagger UI form generation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_request_schema( openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], model_class: Type, schema_name: str, paths: List[str], operation_name: str )
methods.description: Generic method to add a Pydantic model schema as a request body to specified API endpoints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_chat_completion_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a 'ProxyChatCompletionRequest' schema to chat completion endpoints for documentation purposes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_embedding_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds an 'EmbeddingRequest' schema to embedding endpoints for documentation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_responses_api_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds 'ResponsesAPIRequestParams' schema to responses API endpoints for documentation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_llm_api_request_schema_body(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Consolidates addition of various request schemas (chat, embedding, responses API) into the OpenAPI schema.

ctags.pattern: /^    def add_request_body_to_paths(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], paths: List[str], schema_ref: /
ctags.signature: (openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], paths: List[str], schema_ref: str)

ctags.signature: ( openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], model_class: Type, schema_name: str, paths: List[str], operation_name: str )

ctags.pattern: /^    def add_schema_to_components(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], schema_name: str, schema_def: D/
ctags.signature: (openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], schema_name: str, schema_def: Dict[str, Any])
